shared_conventions: Python 3.11+ (tested on 3.14); pandas/numpy/scipy/yfinance/pytest only; stdlib tomllib, sqlite3, argparse, hashlib, json, gzip. No new third-party dependency without a Tier-2 decision.
All paths repo-relative via quant.config; env overrides QUANT_DB_PATH, QUANT_DATA_DIR, QUANT_LEGACY_DB_PATH.
Dates: ISO text YYYY-MM-DD; as_of is always an NSE trading day from quant.data.calendar. Money in rupees. Fractions as fractions. tz stripped once in quant/data/yahoo.py.
Point-in-time: anything a factor reads passes through FactorInputs; FactorInputs raises LookaheadError for dates > as_of. Fundamentals are read with available_from <= as_of.
Never impute a missing input; NaN + a flag. Never overwrite stored factor_values/scores/labels/evaluations; new version or new track.
Every table write goes through quant.db.core.upsert / replace_as_of inside a run context (quant.run.RunContext) that owns run_id.
Every CLI command: --as-of, --db, --config, --dry-run; prints one summary line ending with the row counts written; exit 0 ok / 1 error / 2 blocked / 3 refused.

Tests: pytest -q must pass offline in < 90 s; network tests are @pytest.mark.network and skipped by default; fixtures use recorded Yahoo values (2026-09-05) and the synthetic world from tests/synthetic.py.

Progress: after each workstream append a section to subagents/PROGRESS.md: what was built, test command + result, deviations from MASTER_SPEC with reason, open questions. Commit with message 'WSxx: <summary>'.
If a workstream doc and docs/spec/MASTER_SPEC.md disagree, MASTER_SPEC wins; log the disagreement in PROGRESS.md and in the doc's section 13.
